version.note: Commons does not identify the performing edition. IMSLP separately lists Liang’s annotated score based on the 1947 edition, but does not establish that it was used for this recording. No choice between the first edition and revised text is asserted. The listening map gives approximate passages, not edition-specific bar alignment.

performers.note: Commons credits Eric Xi Xin Liang for performance and recording; the corresponding IMSLP entry explicitly identifies piano. No viola player is credited. The optional or historically ambiguous viola notation does not establish that a viola is heard here, so no additional performer or ensemble timeline is supplied.

date.note: The source’s Summary gives 2024 for this performance/recording. The file was uploaded on 14 July 2024; that is not an established session day. No common session with the other movements is assumed.

place.note: Neither consulted recording entry identifies a venue, city, piano or live-versus-studio setting.

label.note: No record label is identified. IMSLP gives ‘Eric Xi Xin Liang, 2024’ as publisher information for the audio; this documents a publisher credit, not a named commercial label. Neither entry provides a sleeve or label scan.

catalogue.note: No carrier catalogue number is supplied. IMSLP’s file index 922791 is a repository identifier, not a record catalogue number.

matrixTakeSides.note: No matrix, take or side information is supplied. The uploaded FLAC format alone does not establish the original session medium or the number of takes.

credits.value: Eric Xi Xin Liang — performance and recording
credits.note: The source explicitly credits Liang as the recording’s creator. Uploader D. Benjamin Miller is not automatically a transfer or mastering engineer; no separate engineer is named.

date.note: No transfer or mastering date is supplied. The July 2024 upload and February 2026 Wikimedia transcode dates are not substituted for it.

processing.note: No editing, mastering, noise reduction, restoration or source-transfer procedure is documented. The MP3 access encoding is described separately; it does not identify the original recording chain.

digital.format: Wikimedia Commons MP3 access derivative of the uploaded FLAC; timing analysis uses this access derivative

composition.value: Public domain as asserted in Commons’ separate musical-composition notice
composition.note: The composition notice cites Ives’s death in 1954 and publication before 1931; it is separate from the recording licence. The first score was printed in 1920 and circulated in January 1921. The performing edition is unknown: this notice does not independently clear later revisions or editorial additions, and IMSLP marks the revised 1947 score non-public-domain in the United States.

recording.value: Rule 1 — explicit sound-recording licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
recording.note: The opened Commons page explicitly places CC BY 4.0 under ‘Recording’, naming Liang as performer/recording creator. Its separate public-domain composition notice is not used to license the recording. The matching IMSLP recording entry also states CC BY 4.0. Attribution and a licence link are required; this is not a claim that the 2024 sound recording is public domain.

rights.creditLine: Charles Ives, Piano Sonata No. 2, ‘Concord, Mass., 1840–60’, I. Emerson — Eric Xi Xin Liang, piano and recording (2024). Recording licensed CC BY 4.0. Via Wikimedia Commons; MP3 access derivative of the supplied FLAC, with no additional audio editing by Contrapunctus.
